packageRules.description: SQLAlchemy patches ride in the python group; minors (2.1 is a real migration) get their own PR on dashboard approval. separateMultipleMinor, not separateMinorPatch, which would move the patch to its own branch.
The SQLAlchemy minor leaves the python group and waits for approval; keep this rule after the python group rule so its groupName wins.
npm non-major updates in one PR. recharts gets its own PR: reduced-motion.test.tsx and line-geometry.test.tsx pin its real animation output, so a move is reviewed on its own (TBD-528).

Hold TypeScript below 7. TS 7 is the native compiler and ships no JS compiler API, which typescript-eslint (via eslint-config-next, peer typescript <6.1.0) and the AST convention tests under frontend/tests import. Lift once typescript-eslint supports TS 7 and those tests no longer import the compiler API from "typescript".
